service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , USER_ID , DEPT , "LANGUAGE" , EMAIL , USER_NAME_LOC , MENU_PROFILE_CODE , USER_TYPE , WORK_TYPE FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND USER_ID = ${session.USER_ID} AND DEL_FLAG = 'N'

SELECT GWGL.HOUSE_CODE , GWGL.COMPANY_CODE , GWGL.APP_NO , GWGL.APP_SUBJECT , GWGL.APP_TYPE , GWGL.SUX_WKEY1 , GWGL.APP_STATUS , GWLN.APP_USER_ID FROM SGWGL GWGL INNER JOIN SGWLN GWLN ON GWGL.HOUSE_CODE= GWLN.HOUSE_CODE AND GWGL.COMPANY_CODE = GWLN.COMPANY_CODE AND GWGL.APP_NO = GWLN.APP_NO WHERE GWGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND GWGL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND GWGL.APP_STATUS = 'I' AND GWLN.APP_LINE_STATUS ='L04' AND GWLN.APP_USER_ID = ${session.USER_ID}
